reason: Adds configurable browser sound notifications for agent start, completion, and errors using synthesized or locally selected audio files, with settings persisted locally.

summaries.zh: 为智能体开始回答、完成回答和出错提供可配置的浏览器音效通知，并支持本地音频文件与音量设置。
summaries.en: Adds configurable browser sound notifications for agent start, completion, and error events, with local audio files and per-tone volume settings.

capabilities: Tracks the agent answering lifecycle in the browser
Plays synthesized start, done, and error sounds
Allows per-tone volume controls and local custom audio files
